Thatmatt Oakhide is a shield dwarf at the Basilisk Gate Barracks in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.
“
If you're here to report something, don't bother - the Fist don't give a damn.
„
— Thatmatt Oakhide

Involvement

Act Three

Thatmatt is at the barracks with his wife  Bruha Oakhide, looking to report an incident where he was struck on the head and mugged. Unfortunately for him, the Flaming Fist are making him wait to be heard.

Idle banter

Thatmatt chats occasionally with his wife Bruha Oakhide:

  • Bruha Oakhide
    Ravengard's back, I heard. Bet he'll twist some arms, clean up the riffraff.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Duke-types don't care what goes on in our streets.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    Ravengard's no upper-crust softie. He's in charge of the Fist, right?
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    If Ravengard had trained the Fist proper, they'd be out catching crooks, not turning a blind eye.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    There's more Flaming Fist on the streets than ever - maybe they'll whip the place into shape.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Nah. They're too busy 'visiting' Mamzell's guys and gals.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    They do that quite a bit, don't they? It's a shame.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    A damn shame.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    How's your head? That last mugger left a hell of a mark.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Still attached.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    Har-har. We can come back another time, if you ain't feeling up to it?
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Nah, let's see what Portyr has to say - she claimed she'd look into it.

Thatmatt will also occasionally go to  Manip Seyama to check on his status:

  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Oi - I've been mugged. I'm here about my case?
  • Manip Seyama
    We're dealing with an increased number of complaints, sir - please wait your turn.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Right. I'll be outside.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Portyr herself said she was investigating my case?
  • Manip Seyama
    Blaze Portyr will get to you when she gets to you.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    I'm sure.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    My wife and I have been waiting half the day - are you lot gonna help us or not?
  • Manip Seyama
    Take that tone with me again, and you'll see no one. You'll be called when you're called.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Damned Fist...
